integrity: Self-contained symbolic proof and reproducible exact-integer tests, with finite tests not substituted for universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for alternating rank at most four and dimensions at least six; does not extend to larger rank balls without new analysis. General skew-rank character formulas are established literature. The 1975 Delsarte-Goethals full text was unavailable for direct originality comparison; metadata gives month-only date. Independent validation and comprehensive historical priority not established.
title: Sharp endpoint Fourier norms and a single negative shell for alternating rank-four balls
